name: Domino Fever
summary: A polished mobile adaptation of the classic tabletop game developed by Gameloft for Java ME. Players can experience popular variations like Block, Draw, and All Fives across an engaging story mode that takes them through various virtual venues. Featuring colorful 2D graphics, a vibrant cast of AI opponents with unique playing styles, and unlockable customization options, it delivers a stylish and accessible casual board game experience on the go.
